raw.body:
## Summary

This builds on @sleitor's fix in #36330 for #36327 (`babel-plugin-react-compiler` writing the internal `GeneratedSource` Symbol sentinel into a synthesized Babel AST node's `.loc` field, which violates Babel's `Node.loc: SourceLocation | null` contract and crashes `v8.serialize`/jest-worker/`child_process` IPC on any downstream consumer that structurally clones the AST).

The fix itself (`CodegenReactiveFunction.ts`, guarding `identifier.loc = place.loc as any` against `GeneratedSource`) is correct — I independently verified it by grepping every other direct `.loc =` assignment onto a Babel node in the package; all of them already guard against `GeneratedSource` via the existing `withLoc()` helper or an inline check, except this one call site, which #36330 brings in line with the rest of the file.

**The gap this PR fixes:** #36330's added fixture (`.expect.md`) only snapshots the printed source text of the compiled output. I confirmed the printed output is byte-for-byte identical whether the bug is present or fixed — `Node.loc` isn't part of printed source, so that fixture provides no actual regression protection. If the one-line fix were ever reverted, `yarn snap` would not catch it.

## What this adds

A dedicated unit test (`CodegenSymbolLoc-test.ts`, not a fixture) that:
1. Compiles the reported repro through the real `@babel/core` pipeline with `BabelPluginReactCompiler`.
2. Recursively walks the resulting AST asserting no node has `typeof node.loc === 'symbol'`.
3. Asserts the AST is `v8.serialize`-able, matching the exact real-world failure mode from the issue.

## Verification

- Reverted #36330's fix locally, rebuilt, ran this new test: **fails**, correctly reporting the leaked Symbol node and a `v8.serialize` throw matching the issue's reported error.
- Restored the fix, reran: **passes**.
- Ran the full existing `babel-plugin-react-compiler` jest suite (44 tests, 3 projects: main/e2e-forget/e2e-no-forget): all pass.
- Linted the changed source file clean (the new test file is excluded from lint by the repo's existing `**/__tests__/**/*` ignore pattern, consistent with all other test files in this directory).

This PR includes #36330's commit as its base so the new test has something to actually run against; happy to rebase once #36330 lands, or to have the test folded directly into #36330 if the maintainers/author prefer that instead of a separate PR.
raw.title: [compiler] Add regression test for GeneratedSource Symbol leaking into Node.loc (builds on #36330)
